ValidationRule.description: This is used to check if the Work Phone is entered in correct format or not.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false, RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Company_Member', $Profile.Name = 'ANZ CCRM Standard User', NOT(ISBLANK(Work_Phone__c)), NOT REGEX(Work_Phone__c , "^\\+61[0-9]{9}+$" ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The Work Phone entered is not in the correct format.
